text:
maria.nguyen: Heads-up: noticed a full THIRD_PARTY_API_KEY printed in staging worker logs during a retry loop. Example log below. Who should rotate and what's the minimal redaction patch we can deploy now? cc @alex_k @kevin.smith

alex_k: Oof — can you paste the exact log line and which service/file emits it?

maria.nguyen: Log comes from worker-prod-staging (k8s job). Snippet:```INFO 2026-03-16 14:22:11 worker.retry Starting job job-42 retry=3 third_party_key=sk_live_Abc123xyZ9abcdefghijklmnop``` The key is full inline. Emitted from src/worker/runner.py:logger.info(f"Starting job {job.id} retry={attempt} third_party_key={env('THIRD_PARTY_API_KEY')}")

alex_k: Thanks. Immediate fix: stop interpolating secrets into formatted messages. Quick change:```logger.info("Starting job %s retry=%s", job.id, attempt)``` and remove the env value. Also add a regex-based scrubber at the logging formatter to mask long-looking tokens as a short-term guard. I'll open a tiny PR that updates runner.py + adds a Formatter.mask_secrets util.

kevin.smith: +1 to both. Also we need to rotate the leaked key. Do we know who has access to the partner portal where this key was issued? If the key is KMS-wrapped in our vault we can rewrap, otherwise partner rotation is required.

tanisha: Security note: treat this as a low-severity leak (staging), but assume compromise until proven otherwise. Steps: 1) redaction patch -> deploy canary to staging immediately, 2) run grep across log retention to find any other exposures, 3) rotate key with partner or our KMS, 4) update secrets handling checklist so env vars aren't logged. Who owns rotation approval?

maria.nguyen: Will push the redact PR now and trigger a canary deploy. For rotation approval — pinging @kevin.smith since you coordinate third-party creds.

kevin.smith: I can approve. I'll open a ticket on internal tracker (SEC-ROTATIONS) and contact partner-ops for rotation window. If partner can't rotate quickly we should revoke and reissue a new key and update the envelope in our KMS.

sec-bot: [runbook] Key Exposure runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/key-exposure — follow steps 1-5 and tag #sec-rotations. Auto-checklist: log-scrub, rotation-request, canary, post-rotate audit.

maria.nguyen: Thanks all — PR #1543 created for redact + logging scrubber. I'll attach grep results here in a bit and add the SEC-ROTATIONS ticket once kevin confirms the approver.

kevin.smith: Confirmed — I'll approve the rotation ticket once it's created. Also reminder: add a CI lint that rejects commits that do os.getenv(... ) inside f-strings/log interpolation containing "KEY"/"TOKEN"/"SECRET". Prevents regressions.

maria.nguyen: Good idea, adding that to the PR checklist. Will follow up with timeline in the ticket. :thumbsup:
